method: Git-tracked source plus Go 1.27.1 go/parser; syntactic observations followed by risk-prioritized source inspection. No product tests executed. See README.md for scope and interpretation.
assessment_interpretation: Member slots are initial-screen observations, except explicit finding/bounded-inspection, sample-dependent-predicate and worker-context-inspected values. Behavioral meaning is a source/name placeholder, not a completed semantic assessment. Full conclusions live in the linked report/evidence. File-level and non-Go assessments use seven prose values in the same order. Q-sensitive is selected by worker, sleep, direct random call, polling or conditional-skip signals; others receive Q-semantic unless an inspected scope or named callback candidate overrides it.

assessment_legend.helper-role-deferred: Helper/method name and source span identify the role; callers own its behavioral meaning, which remains deferred beyond linked inspection.
assessment_legend.setup-role-deferred: Setup/init declaration; concrete setup behavior is deferred beyond linked inspection.
assessment_legend.sample-dependent-predicate: Inspected F05: mandatory predicate depends on random samples from production; see per-owner impact.
assessment_legend.worker-context-inspected: Inspected F03: fatal assertion executes on a non-test worker; completion consequence is caller-specific.
assessment_legend.named-behavior: Screening placeholder: group name declares the behavior; oracle preview/sites and referenced local declarations show the observed checks. Name alone is not semantic validation.
assessment_legend.direct: Direct require/assert/testing failure calls found; predicate sensitivity is not established just by presence.
assessment_legend.mock: Mock expectations provide an oracle despite no direct assertion calls.
assessment_legend.delegated: Inspect the linked same-package declaration candidates for assertions/scenarios; this is syntactic name resolution, not a type-checked call graph.
assessment_legend.implicit: Smoke/no-panic, benchmark, fuzzer, or caller-owned oracle; deeper inspection must determine the intended guarantee.
assessment_legend.finding: See precise finding scope; this does not condemn every scenario in the enclosing group.
assessment_legend.bounded-inspection: See evidence.md inspected scope; no universal validity claim.
assessment_legend.semantic-check-deferred: Initial source screening completed; independently validating every predicate against production semantics remains deferred.
assessment_legend.virtual-present: Lexical synctest bubble found; only code inside its bubble has virtual time.
assessment_legend.workers-or-waits: Explicit worker, delay or polling observed; join/readiness and callback context require source inspection.
assessment_legend.no-direct-scheduler-signal: No selected scheduler calls in this declaration; callees can still block or run workers.
assessment_legend.environment-touched: Environment/cwd mutation present; restoration/parallel compatibility requires the exact caller context.
assessment_legend.package-state-present: File contains package variables; this does not prove that this member mutates them.
assessment_legend.ownership-check-deferred: Initial screen does not prove fixture/resource isolation.
assessment_legend.random-observed: Direct random calls found; fixed seeds and crypto payloads differ from stochastic pass/fail assumptions.
assessment_legend.time-or-caller-dependent: No determinism guarantee; random/time behavior can be in helpers or production.
assessment_legend.named-scenarios: Run sites are retained; dynamic names are grouped by source domain, not expanded by execution.
assessment_legend.assertion-sites: Source-located assertions provide diagnostic anchors; failure quality depends on predicates/context.
assessment_legend.callee-or-runtime: Diagnostics come from helpers, mock enforcement, returned errors, panics or benchmark/fuzz runtime.

deferred_questions.Q-worker-callback: F03 candidate: gomock DoAndReturn callback in a connection scenario that launches conn.run; inspect exact callback execution owner and failure completion before repair. Not counted as a confirmed site.
deferred_questions.Q-semantic: Full predicate-by-predicate production-contract comparison and defect sensitivity beyond the recorded initial screen. No absent-finding entry is certified correct.
deferred_questions.Q-sensitive: Deeper helper/callback ownership, failure-path cleanup, timing/randomness and platform context for this specific screened group; follow the prioritized repair batches, not blind reruns.
deferred_questions.Q-beyond-inspected-scope: Only the specific scope in evidence.md or named findings was deeply inspected; other branches and stronger guarantees remain unverified.
deferred_questions.Q-infrastructure: External tool/service availability, full generator/collector semantics, uncommon environment and platform combinations not executed in this audit.
